A layout table renders its rows as list items, and those markers honour the bullets option like any other list

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<table><tr><td>alpha</td><td>beta</td></tr><tr><td>a</td><td>b</td><td>c</td></tr></table>", new ConversionOptions { Bullets = "*+-" });
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
